_comment: 076 screenshot harness: url-path -> fixture file. capture.py serves each of these from the sibling JSON, rewriting the fields named in that fixture's top-level `_fresh` list relative to run time. Query strings are ignored (path-only match), so a route whose widget fetches several shapes on one path (e.g. /api/configs.json, /api/metrics.json) is served ONE union fixture that satisfies every consumer's mount read.
